tenants.name: Qamar Devices LLC
tenants.sells: Laptop, phone, tablet and monitor rental and sales to companies
faq: Rental prices include accidental-damage cover. Theft is not covered.
Company rentals need a copy of the trade licence before delivery.
The minimum rental is one month. Rentals longer than 12 months go to the general manager.
Delivery and setup (Q-SVC-001) is charged once per order.

tenants.name: Rimal Event Supply
tenants.sells: Event equipment rental: staging, screens, audio, furniture, tents, power
faq: A setup crew (R-CRW-001, one shift per order) is required for stages larger than 12 m², LED screens larger than 6 m², and all tents.
A 30% deposit confirms a booking. Only the operations manager confirms availability.
Orders under 2,000 SAR before VAT are not accepted.
